parameters.name: MatchType
parameters.description:
Specifies how to match the origin pool name. The default is `exact`. Valid values:

- `fuzzy`: Performs a fuzzy search.

- `exact`: Performs an exact match.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the origin pool.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description:
Specifies how the results are sorted. By default, results are sorted by ID in descending order. To sort by ID in ascending order, set this parameter to `id`. IDs increase with creation time.

- id: Sorts by ID in descending order.

- id: Sorts by ID in ascending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The value must be an integer from 1 to 500. If you specify a value greater than 500, the system uses 500.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. To get this ID, call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation.
